decision_rule.HARMFUL: owner decision 25's Method B form, read FIRST: a MEASURED LOSS on either guard -- a point estimate of official pooled SLU micro F1 or of intent (joint scenario+action) accuracy below -h (-1.1218 / -1.0051), or a CI95 UPPER bound below zero. An interval that straddles zero with the point estimate inside the margin is NOT harmful.
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: BOTH guards are non-inferior at the own-null margins: the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta exceeds -1.1218 AND the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -1.0051. Where an interval straddles zero the verdict states 'non-inferiority proven, superiority not claimed' in those words.
decision_rule.comparator: the sealed dual-store anchor SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DUAL-STORE-TRAIN-FOLD-A-ANCHOR-RECOVERY-V1, and nothing else, for every gating clause
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable of section primary_deliverables is measured and reported whatever the verdict word is, including under HARMFUL. A cost measurement is not contingent on a quality outcome.
decision_rule.harmful_consequence: a HARMFUL cell enters no default plan, the per-role rendering stays the default, and the throughput report's lever L2 (drop the Planner) must NOT then be credited with L1's gain: four fifths of the Planner's apparent cost is this toggle, which is why L1 is evaluated first (report section 6, ranking note).
decision_rule.headroom_trigger: AN EFFICIENCY CELL DOES NOT COUNT TOWARD OWNER DECISION 30's HEADROOM TRIGGER. This cell consumes a flight slot and a share of the GPU budget; it does not consume a headroom attempt, and a NEUTRAL result here is not evidence about the bar.
decision_rule.neutral_rule: the SLURP v2 design's section 15 resolution 5 admits a NEUTRAL switch into the default plan ONLY IF IT LOWERS COST. This one does, measurably, which is the whole point of the cell. On NEUTRAL the key enters the SLURP default plan and EVERY LATER CELL AND THE TEST READ ADOPT IT; from that moment a cell registered against a sealed PER-ROLE arm is registered against a comparator that is no longer the default, and its package MUST SAY SO -- the same clause the B8a package used for the delivery node.
decision_rule.not_a_bar_attempt: the verdict states the official pooled SLU the arm reaches as a FACT beside the anchor's 48.53 / 77.96, never as a claim, and nothing here is 'replicated on the same roster'.
decision_rule.not_evaluable: if either guard's interval is so wide that its CI95 lower bound falls below -h without a point estimate below -h, the cell is NOT NEUTRAL and NOT HARMFUL: it is NON-INFERIORITY NOT PROVEN, the key does not enter the default plan, and the remedy is the configuration's own replicate (owner decision 38's first clause), not a re-read of this one.

The first request of a row is the Perception request, and under this factor it is NOT byte-identical to the anchor's: the tools array is added to it. What IS claimed, and what the smoke proves, is (a) every REVIEWER request is byte-identical to the anchor's request at the same position of the same sample id, and (b) the perception, solver and planner requests differ from the anchor's in exactly one key, tools, with tool_choice still "none" -- i.e. {k: v for k, v in on if k != 'tools'} == off. not_claimed: NO EFFECTIVENESS CLAIM. This cell asserts nothing about SLU F1, intent accuracy or any quality metric except that they do not fall. It is not expected to improve anything and cannot be admitted for improving anything.

NO SUPERIORITY, GENERALIZATION, PAPER-SCALE OR HELD-OUT CLAIM. TRAIN Fold A is an exposed discovery roster and every claim of this cell stops at it. Fold B, DEV-1000 and the test split stay untouched and unread.
NO CLAIM ABOUT OTHER CARRIERS. The measurement is SLURP native, np4, ctx24k, id_slot per-sample. Earnings and Audio2Tool are not addressed, and a saving measured here is not a saving claimed there.
NO CLAIM THAT THE PLANNER OR THE REVIEWER IS EXPENSIVE. Their neighbours' tools shape is. The report's levers L2 and L6 are separate, effectiveness-bearing questions and are not decided here.

NO GEOMETRY CLAIM. np6 / np8 and -ub remain out of scope (report L8 and L5(b)). They become interesting only after the row stops being prefill-bound, which is a consequence this cell may MEASURE but does not act on.

NO CLAIM THAT THE PREDICTED 50.1 % IS THE REALIZED SAVING. 50.1 % is derived from character-level longest-common-prefix proxies over sealed requests plus llama.cpp's common-prefix rule. The realized token-level number is what this cell measures, and it may be smaller or larger.

NO CLAIM ABOUT WHAT THREE MORE ROLES DO WITH THE TOOL DEFINITIONS. Showing a tool-free role the definitions inserts the template's tool paragraph into its system message and the model can react to it. That is exactly what the NEUTRALITY guard is for; the cell measures the outcome, it does not explain it.
NOTHING ABOUT ANY IN-FLIGHT CELL. Cells registered against the anchor or against a per-role base are unaffected by this registration and no number here is evidence for or against any of them.

purpose: Decide efficiency cell EFF-1: constant native tool-schema rendering (item E17, merged at d6fade1e; lever L1 of docs/results/2026-09-19-slurp-throughput-root-cause-v1.md) on the sealed dual-store ANCHOR base, TRAIN Fold A 1,080 rows. The PURPOSE is THROUGHPUT -- prefilled prompt tokens per row and GPU hours per 1,080 rows -- and the ADMISSION RULE is NEUTRAL on the official number. The SLURP flights are prefill-bound at 488-536 seconds per million prefilled tokens across four sealed native runs, and the dominant cause of the prefilled count is prefix-cache breakage: the Reviewer is the only tool-bearing role, the task instruction is byte-identical across all four roles, and the chat template renders the tools array inside the system message, so with one slot pinned per row the block toggles on at contact 3 and off at contact 5 and each toggle invalidates the whole KV prefix, speech packet included. Holding the rendering constant is expected to halve the row's prefill. This cell measures that and proves the official number does not move.
quality_gate: no task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,080 outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist, and not before the registered STOP condition passes. The efficiency read may proceed from the sealed receipts, trace and server log as soon as the manifest seals, because it touches no answer, reference or quality field.

resume_recovery_clause: owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18. If an attempt dies of an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged -- never a harness or config defect -- the one allowed recovery may be a RESUME-RECOVERY under item E10 instead of a re-fly: every complete row of the aborted attempt is kept without selection, every partial or unstarted row is flown under the same run id, and the merged manifest declares the predecessor attempt with its trace hash, kept-row list and that list's hash. It changes no question, roster, factor, comparator, decision rule or cap, and the run-cumulative budget must be re-checked because a resumed attempt and its predecessor share one run id. A resumed EFFICIENCY read must additionally state the split of its GPU hours and prefilled tokens across attempts, because a merged manifest's cost is the sum of two lease windows and a per-row rate computed over the merged manifest alone would be wrong.

criteria: 1. DELIVERY. 4 of 4 rows delivered, five contacts per row (perception, solver, reviewer x2, planner), no row above the bounded ceiling of 11.

2. CONSTANCY. The sealed native-episode receipt carries the saea-native-tool-schema-rendering-v1 block on every row with mode "constant", rendered_tool_names ["saea-tool-task-contract-v1"], one contact row per realized contact, authority_tool_names [] on perception / solver / planner against ["saea-tool-task-contract-v1"] on the two Reviewer contacts, and distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1 on EVERY row.

3. THE REVIEWER BYTES DO NOT MOVE. Each Reviewer MODEL_REQUEST of each of the four rows is BYTE-IDENTICAL (request_sha256) to the sealed anchor's request at the same position of the same sample id, read read-only from runs/SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DUAL-STORE-TRAIN-FOLD-A-ANCHOR-RECOVERY-V1/. The anchor has NO four-row smoke of its own -- it was flown once, directly, over the 1,080-row roster -- so the comparison is against the anchor's own sealed trace restricted to these four sample ids, which are members of that roster. Never write to that trace, and read no answer, reference or quality field of it.

4. THE OTHER ROLES DIFFER ONLY BY tools. For each of the perception, solver and planner requests, the request payload minus the tools key is byte-identical to the anchor's, and tool_choice is still "none" on all three. A request whose predecessor response differs is REPORTED, not silently excused (greedy decoding at temperature 0 is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions); a differing PERCEPTION payload outside the tools key is a failure, because it precedes every generation and nothing else can explain it.

5. FIT. One *.request-fit.json per realized contact with every_request_fits true and every required-token count below 24,576; the worker prints a seal; the manifest seals clean; the tree is still clean.

6. THE POINT OF THE SMOKE -- THE CACHE. The server-reported cached-token share per position, read from the resident session's server.log joined to these contacts per slot, shows the first-Reviewer and Planner contacts NO LONGER RE-PREFILL THE PACKET: their cached share rises from the anchor-era 23.6 % and 19.8 % toward the same-tools handover's 83.5 %, and the speech-packet re-decode share at those two positions falls from 100 % toward 0. Four rows cannot establish a rate, so no threshold gates the smoke on this number -- but a cached share that does NOT move at those two positions means the mechanism did not reach the server, and that IS a failure.

7. FINITE COMPLETIONS. Any row whose terminal_disposition.reason is "finite_completion" is RETAINED and reported, never treated as an error. Four rows are very unlikely to hit the 512-token cap, so the expected count is zero. What is NOT acceptable is an abort on finish_reason "length": that would mean the declared policy did not reach the runtime.

8. AUTHORITY. Zero tool calls emitted by perception, solver or planner is the expected result; a call refused by _RoleAuthorityRail is reported with its role and sample id and is not a failure of the flight, because the rail is the designed behaviour -- but it is recorded as the first observed behavioural consequence of showing a tool-free role the definitions.
